ai_summary: Rawalpindi homes can use five Pak Clay khaprail profiles, from natural red to green glazed. Quantity should be planned from roof surface area plus a margin, and delivery terms are agreed per order. Pak Clay, in Lahore since 1982, offers a free WhatsApp sample.

faqs.question: Where can I buy khaprail tiles in Rawalpindi?
faqs.answer: Pak Clay has an Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, near Rawalpindi, plus its Lahore workshop. Call first, as listed hours are Mon-Sat 9am-9pm and Sun 1pm-6pm.

faqs.question: How much do khaprail tiles cost in Rawalpindi?
faqs.answer: Rates depend on profile, finish, quantity, season, transport and ridge pieces, and may be per piece or per square foot. Ask for a written quote with unit and date.

faqs.question: Which khaprail profile is better, natural red or glazed?
faqs.answer: Neither wins every time. Natural red ages quietly and suits brick and stone, while glazed is bolder and easier to wipe clean. Compare outdoor samples.

faqs.question: Does Pak Clay deliver khaprail tiles to Rawalpindi?
